goals: Verify the Login Page successfully authenticates a user and redirects them to the default authenticated path.
Verify the Login Page displays a loading state during the sign-in process.
activities: Clear all mock calls.
Render the login page.
Assert that the 'Login to your account' heading is displayed.
Clear all mock calls.
Mock the `signIn` function to simulate a delayed sign-in process.
Render the login page.
Type an email address into the email input field.
Type a password into the password input field.
Click the 'Login' button.
Wait for the 'Logging in...' message to appear.
Assert that the 'Logging in...' message is displayed.
Clear all mock calls.
Mock the `signIn` function to simulate a successful sign-in.
Mock the `useNavigate` hook to capture navigation calls.
Render the login page.
Type an email address into the email input field.
Type a password into the password input field.
Click the 'Login' button.
Wait for the navigation function to be called.
Assert that the navigation function was called once.
Assert that the navigation function was called to redirect to the default authenticated path.
